sentences.text:
DATED:- 18th DECEMBER, 2023 P.C:-
1) Heard the learned Counsel for the applicant and the learned APP for the State.

2) This application is preferred for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No. 850 of 2022, registered with Vile Parle Police Station, Mumbai for the offences punishable under Section 120B, 409, 411, 420, 413, 465, 467, 468 and 471 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("the Penal Code") and Section 66 (d) and 66 (e) of Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008.

sentences.text: 3) At the outset, the learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that the co-accused in this FIR have been granted interim protection by an order dated 11th October, 2022.
4) It seems that a number of applications were listed before this Court on 11th October, 2022 and this Court directed that no coercive steps shall be taken against the applicants till next date.
5) In view of the above, it may be expedient to hear this application along with applications in which the interim has been granted by the Court.
6) Stand over to 15th January, 2024 along with ABA No. 2682 of 2022 and connected applications.
7) In the meanwhile, the applicant shall not be arrested in this case.

[N. J. JAMADAR, J.]
